title: 激光设备火灾与急停
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/119_激光设备火灾与急停.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/119_激光设备火灾与急停/src.py

points.K1: 风琴管阴燃：火从光路里烧起来
points.K2: 清走可燃物，加工区配灭火器
points.K8: 停机后报告，确认再复位
points.K9: 冒烟起火：停光、关盖、报告
points.K10: 自动灭火装置报警：别开盖
points.K11: 精密激光设备：二氧化碳优于干粉
points.K12: 金属着火：D 类灭火器或干砂
points.K13: 手动出光：双手都在外面

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在激光切割机旁，指着红色急停按钮
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a closed laser cutter and points to a red emergency stop button, smiling at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲激光设备的火灾与急停。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 切割机内火苗变大，阿杰伸手要掀盖子
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a growing flame inside a closed laser cutter and a student's hand reaching for the lid. No text.
shots.narration: 机器里火苗变大，阿杰想掀盖看看。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研按下急停，按住盖子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student presses the red emergency stop button and keeps the lid of the laser cutter closed.
shots.narration: 小研按下急停：先停机，别开盖。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 王老师赶来，手边是二氧化碳灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hurries over with a carbon dioxide fire extinguisher in hand, standing on the exit side.
shots.narration: 王老师赶来：用对灭火器才行。

shots.section_title: 风琴管阴燃：火从光路里烧起来
shots.scene: 切割头上方的风琴管被烧穿一个黑洞
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a folding bellows cover above a cutting head with a blackened burned hole and a glowing red spot inside. No text.
shots.narration: 风琴管护着光路，也会被烧穿。
overlay: 风琴管阴燃：火从光路里烧起来

shots.section_title: 风琴管阴燃：火从光路里烧起来
shots.scene: 光束偏移打到护套上
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a misaligned beam hitting the inside of the bellows cover, a dirty lens and dust nearby. No text.
shots.narration: 光路偏了、镜片脏了，光就打到护套。

shots.section_title: 风琴管阴燃：火从光路里烧起来
shots.scene: 火点下面是气管和电缆，机架上满是黑灰
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the burning spot sits right above gas hoses and cables, and the machine frame is covered in black dust. No text.
shots.narration: 下面是气管电缆，积灰正好是燃料。

shots.section_title: 风琴管阴燃：火从光路里烧起来
shots.scene: 镜头拉远，红点还在阴燃
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a zoomed out view of the machine with a small red glowing spot still smouldering, a clock beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 阴燃不会自己灭，越拖越危险。

shots.section_title: 清走可燃物，加工区配灭火器
shots.scene: 保护膜、纸箱、碎屑被清走
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: protective film, cardboard boxes and scrap pieces being cleared away from a laser work area. No text.
shots.narration: 保护膜、纸箱、碎屑，及时清走。
overlay: 清走可燃物，加工区配灭火器

shots.section_title: 清走可燃物，加工区配灭火器
shots.scene: 擦过酒精的工件晾干，酒精瓶盖好远离焊点
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a workpiece wiped with alcohol drying first, the capped alcohol bottle placed far from the weld spot. No text.
shots.narration: 酒精擦过等干再切，瓶子盖好放远。

shots.section_title: 清走可燃物，加工区配灭火器
shots.scene: 加工区墙上挂着灭火器和灭火毯
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fire extinguisher and a fire blanket mounted on the wall right next to a laser work area, a fire extinguisher sign above. No text.
shots.narration: 加工区配好灭火器和灭火毯。

shots.section_title: 什么样的火要警惕
shots.scene: 加工点闪一下的小火苗随光头移走
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tiny flash of flame at the cutting point that moves along with the laser head and disappears. No text.
shots.narration: 加工点闪一下小火苗，随光移走。

shots.section_title: 什么样的火要警惕
shots.scene: 光头已经移走，原处火苗越烧越大
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the laser head has moved on but the flame at the old spot keeps growing bigger, a warning burst around it. No text.
shots.narration: 光已移走，原处还在烧，就要警惕。

shots.section_title: 暂停键：停出光、停运动
shots.scene: 机器顶部的启动键和暂停键
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a start button and a pause button on top of a desktop laser cutter, the pause button highlighted. No text.
shots.narration: 暂停键随时能按，按了没有坏处。

shots.section_title: 暂停键：停出光、停运动
shots.scene: 按下暂停，光束和横梁停住
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a finger pressing the pause button, the beam switching off and the moving gantry stopping. No text.
shots.narration: 暂停或进给保持，只停出光和运动。

shots.section_title: 暂停键：停出光、停运动
shots.scene: 暂停后电源和高压指示灯仍亮
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: after pausing, the power and high voltage indicator lamps on the cabinet are still lit. No text.
shots.narration: 电源和高压，其实还开着。

shots.section_title: 急停：驱动和高压全断
shots.scene: 【实拍】按下红色急停按钮（设备待机不出光，遮挡品牌）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a hand pressing down a red mushroom emergency stop button on a laser machine control panel.
shots.narration: 情况严重，立即按急停。

shots.section_title: 急停：驱动和高压全断
shots.scene: 急停后驱动和高压线路全部断开
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: after the emergency stop, the drive and high voltage lines in the machine all break apart. No text.
shots.narration: 急停一按，驱动、高压全部断开。

shots.section_title: 急停：驱动和高压全断
shots.scene: 机头卡住、异响、大量浓烟三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a stuck laser head, a cracking sound and thick black smoke. No text.
shots.narration: 机头卡死、异响、浓烟，直接急停。

shots.section_title: 急停：驱动和高压全断
shots.scene: 正常关机：先停光挂枪，再关开关
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: normal shutdown order, release the trigger, hang the torch, then switch off, and a hand slapping the switch mid weld crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 正常关机先停光挂枪，再关开关。

shots.section_title: 拿不准，就拉总电源
shots.scene: 【实拍】操作者指认墙上的总电源开关（不操作）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: an operator pointing to the main isolating switch box on the wall beside a laser machine.
shots.narration: 进实验室，先认急停和总电源。

shots.section_title: 拿不准，就拉总电源
shots.scene: 总电源开关前堆着箱子，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: boxes piled in front of a main power switch box, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 开关前不堆东西，伸手就能够到。

shots.section_title: 拿不准，就拉总电源
shots.scene: 总开关拉下，激光器和冷水机一起断电
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the main switch pulled down and the laser source, the chiller and the extractor all losing power together. No text.
shots.narration: 总开关一拉，所有设备一起断电。

shots.section_title: 拿不准，就拉总电源
shots.scene: 阿杰犹豫，问号变成拉闸的手
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a question mark above a hesitant student turning into a hand pulling the main switch down. No text.
shots.narration: 还在犹豫，就别想了，直接拉闸。

shots.section_title: 安全地垫：一踩全停
shots.scene: 机器前的安全地垫，一只脚踩上去机器停
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pressure sensitive safety mat in front of a large laser machine, a foot stepping on it and the machine stopping. No text.
shots.narration: 机前安全地垫，一踩整台机器停。

shots.section_title: 安全地垫：一踩全停
shots.scene: 人们凑到机器前面看，地垫护住
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: visitors leaning toward the front of the machine while the safety mat under their feet stops the machine. No text.
shots.narration: 人想凑近看，地垫保护人。

shots.section_title: 安全地垫：一踩全停
shots.scene: 定期测试地垫和急停，记录本上打勾
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a technician testing the safety mat and the emergency stop, then ticking a test log. No text.
shots.narration: 地垫、急停定期测试，试一次记一次。

shots.section_title: 安全地垫：一踩全停
shots.scene: 地垫上压重物、急停被胶带缠住，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a heavy box placed on the safety mat to bypass it and an emergency stop taped over, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不准屏蔽、绕过停机装置。

shots.section_title: 停机后报告，确认再复位
shots.scene: 阿杰按下急停后打电话报告老师
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, after pressing the emergency stop, phones the safety administrator to report.
shots.narration: 按了急停、拉了总闸，马上报告。
overlay: 停机后报告，确认再复位

shots.section_title: 停机后报告，确认再复位
shots.scene: 老李查明原因后，旋转拔出急停按钮
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the facility engineer checks the cause, then twists and pulls the emergency stop button out to reset it. No text.
shots.narration: 查明原因、负责人确认，旋出复位。

shots.section_title: 停机后报告，确认再复位
shots.scene: 学生自己随手复位开机，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student resetting the emergency stop and restarting the machine on his own, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不要自己随手复位开机。

shots.section_title: 冒烟起火：停光、关盖、报告
shots.scene: 按下暂停或急停，机盖保持关闭
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand pressing the stop button while the lid of the laser cutter stays closed over a small flame. No text.
shots.narration: 起火先停光，机盖保持关闭。
overlay: 冒烟起火：停光、关盖、报告

shots.section_title: 冒烟起火：停光、关盖、报告
shots.scene: 掀盖扇风让火变旺，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person lifting the lid and fanning the flame which grows bigger, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 开盖扇风，火会更旺。

shots.section_title: 冒烟起火：停光、关盖、报告
shots.scene: 拿手机拍视频，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person filming a smoking machine with a phone instead of stopping it, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 先处置，不要先拍视频。

shots.section_title: 冒烟起火：停光、关盖、报告
shots.scene: 火势变大，人撤离，手机拨119和120
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a growing fire, people leaving through the exit and a phone showing 119 and 120. No text.
shots.narration: 控制不住撤离拨119，有人受伤拨120。

shots.section_title: 冒烟起火：停光、关盖、报告
shots.scene: 报告链：实验室负责人、学院、保卫处
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a reporting chain with three steps, a lab supervisor, a college office and a campus security office. No text.
shots.narration: 起火受伤都要逐级报告。

shots.section_title: 自动灭火装置报警：别开盖
shots.scene: 机器旁的小盒子：自动灭火装置在监测
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small box mounted beside the laser cutter with a sensor icon watching for smoke and flame. No text.
shots.narration: 有的设备装了自动灭火装置。
overlay: 自动灭火装置报警：别开盖

shots.section_title: 自动灭火装置报警：别开盖
shots.scene: 报警：切断激光电源，向机内喷二氧化碳
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an alarm bell ringing, the laser power line cut and carbon dioxide gas spraying inside the closed machine. No text.
shots.narration: 报警时，断激光电源、喷二氧化碳。

shots.section_title: 自动灭火装置报警：别开盖
shots.scene: 警报响，阿杰站住向老师招手，不冲去开盖
shots.prompt_en: The young male student hears an alarm, stays calm and waves to the safety administrator instead of rushing to open the lid.
shots.narration: 警报响了不开盖，让老师知道。

shots.section_title: 自动灭火装置报警：别开盖
shots.scene: 老师指挥用灭火毯和灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator directs the next step, a fire blanket and a fire extinguisher ready beside the machine.
shots.narration: 气体没灭，再听老师指挥灭火。

shots.section_title: 精密激光设备：二氧化碳优于干粉
shots.scene: 【实拍】二氧化碳灭火器铭牌特写，手指指向适用火灾类别图标
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a finger pointing to the fire class icons on the label of a carbon dioxide fire extinguisher.
shots.narration: 灭火器按铭牌上的火灾类别选。
overlay: 精密激光设备：二氧化碳优于干粉

shots.section_title: 精密激光设备：二氧化碳优于干粉
shots.scene: 干粉喷进电子元件，残留吸潮腐蚀
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: dry powder covering electronic boards inside a machine, then moisture drops and rust spots spreading. No text.
shots.narration: 干粉残留吸潮，会腐蚀精密元件。

shots.section_title: 精密激光设备：二氧化碳优于干粉
shots.scene: 二氧化碳挤走氧气，散去不留残渣
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: carbon dioxide pushing oxygen away from a flame, then the gas drifting off and leaving the boards clean. No text.
shots.narration: 二氧化碳灭火后散掉，不留残渣。

shots.section_title: 精密激光设备：二氧化碳优于干粉
shots.scene: 带电设备旁的二氧化碳灭火器打勾，水桶打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a carbon dioxide extinguisher with a tick beside a powered laser machine, a water bucket crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 带电激光设备，优先二氧化碳，不用水。

shots.section_title: 精密激光设备：二氧化碳优于干粉
shots.scene: 只有干粉灭火器时也拿起来用
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: only a dry powder extinguisher on the wall, a hand taking it to fight a small fire, a person icon with a shield. No text.
shots.narration: 手边只有干粉也能用，人身安全第一。

shots.section_title: 金属着火：D 类灭火器或干砂
shots.scene: 钛、镁金属屑燃烧发出白光
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: titanium and magnesium chips burning with a bright white glow on a cutting table. No text.
shots.narration: 钛、镁等金属也会燃烧，很难扑灭。
overlay: 金属着火：D 类灭火器或干砂

shots.section_title: 金属着火：D 类灭火器或干砂
shots.scene: 水、二氧化碳、普通干粉三个图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, water, a carbon dioxide extinguisher and an ordinary dry powder extinguisher, all crossed out over a metal fire. No text.
shots.narration: 金属火不用水，不用二氧化碳。

shots.section_title: 金属着火：D 类灭火器或干砂
shots.scene: D类灭火器和干砂桶覆盖金属火
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a special metal fire extinguisher and a bucket of dry sand used to cover burning metal chips. No text.
shots.narration: 用D类灭火器或干砂覆盖。

shots.section_title: 手动出光：双手都在外面
shots.scene: 切割时安安静静，喷嘴下金属瞬间汽化
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a quiet laser cutting head, and a zoomed view under the nozzle where metal vaporises violently. No text.
shots.narration: 切割很安静，喷嘴下金属瞬间汽化。
overlay: 手动出光：双手都在外面

shots.section_title: 手动出光：双手都在外面
shots.scene: 对中出光时，两手按在机外两个按钮上
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an operator firing a single alignment pulse with both hands pressing two buttons outside the machine. No text.
shots.narration: 手动出光，双手都按在外面按钮上。

shots.section_title: 手动出光：双手都在外面
shots.scene: 一只手按钮、一只手伸进机内，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one hand on the fire button and the other hand inside the machine near the nozzle, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 绝不能一手按钮，一手在里面。

shots.section_title: 手动出光：双手都在外面
shots.scene: 厚透明塑料块被细光斑打穿
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a thick clear plastic block with a thin hole burned straight through from top to bottom by a single pulse. No text.
shots.narration: 细细光斑，一下就打穿厚塑料块。

shots.section_title: 手动出光：双手都在外面
shots.scene: 出光前环顾一圈喊一声；按钮被绑住打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an operator looking around and calling out before firing, and a two hand button taped down to one hand use crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 出光前看一圈，双手按钮不能绑住。

shots.section_title: 手指不垫在喷嘴下
shots.scene: 手指垫在喷嘴下量高度，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a finger placed under the cutting nozzle to measure its height, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不要用手指垫在喷嘴下量高度。

shots.section_title: 手指不垫在喷嘴下
shots.scene: 手指一滑，光穿过去，疼痛符号
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the finger slipping and a beam path passing through the spot, a pain burst icon. No text.
shots.narration: 手指一滑，光就穿过去，非常疼。

shots.section_title: 手指不垫在喷嘴下
shots.scene: 用塞尺工具量喷嘴高度
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a feeler gauge tool used to measure the nozzle height with the machine stopped. No text.
shots.narration: 量高度用工具，手指别伸进去。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 清可燃物、看火情、配灭火器三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a broom clearing scraps, an eye watching a flame and a fire extinguisher. No text.
shots.narration: 清走可燃物，盯住火情，配好灭火器。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 暂停、急停、总电源开关三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a pause button, a red emergency stop button and a main power switch. No text.
shots.narration: 暂停、急停、总电源，拿不准就拉闸。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 二氧化碳灭火器、D类灭火器、双手按钮
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a carbon dioxide extinguisher, a metal fire extinguisher and two hands on two buttons. No text.
shots.narration: 按铭牌选灭火器，出光双手在外。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣站在仪器设备间，手里拿着空白的设备台账
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a lab equipment room holding a blank equipment ledger and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：仪器设备安全管理。
